# OASIS

> A curated digital space to read, write, and explore insightful stories, ideas, and perspectives.

OASIS brings together designers, developers, and writers to share deep insights on design systems, code architecture, creative engineering, and modern culture.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://oasis-blog-one.vercel.app/): OASIS landing page, featuring curated stories and publication showcase.
- [Discover](https://oasis-blog-one.vercel.app/discover): Explore curated articles and trending topics across design and technology.
- [About](https://oasis-blog-one.vercel.app/about): Learn about OASIS mission, principles, and community.
- [Support](https://oasis-blog-one.vercel.app/support): Frequently asked questions and help center.
- [Contact](https://oasis-blog-one.vercel.app/contact): Get in touch with the OASIS team.

## Optional

- [Terms of Service](https://oasis-blog-one.vercel.app/terms): Terms and conditions for using OASIS.
- [Privacy Policy](https://oasis-blog-one.vercel.app/privacy): OASIS privacy and data policies.
- [Cookie Policy](https://oasis-blog-one.vercel.app/cookies): Information about cookies used on OASIS.
